review_state.title: The Cleaner Growth System Most Busy Teams Are Missing
review_state.description: Busy founders are scaling on broken systems. Learn the practical growth system that cuts chaos, automates the right things, and keeps humans where they matter.
review_state.preview_text: Most growing teams are not failing because of effort. They are failing because they are running a 2025 business on a 2019 operating system. The work is piling up, the team is stretched, and the output still feels thin.
